PlayStash frontend 17.2.3

This is the unmodified web ZIP and runtime definitions from the PlayStash frontend release.
Original authors: Alkan Alper, Schäfer Philip GbR / Phalcode.
PlayStash modifications are available in the source repository listed below.
License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
The complete original license is included in LICENSE.

Source: https://github.com/PlayStash/playstash-frontend/tree/de20c44fe57a404e32ff450aaf4977f0a107efcf
Release: https://github.com/PlayStash/playstash-frontend/releases/tag/v17.2.3
License source: https://github.com/PlayStash/playstash-frontend/blob/de20c44fe57a404e32ff450aaf4977f0a107efcf/LICENSE

The ZIP preserves the frontend's original-license and third-party-license modules.
Full dependency license texts remain available in the web interface under
Settings > About > Open Source Licenses. Their exact paths and hashes are recorded
in provenance.json alongside the unmodified release ZIP and runtime file hashes.

These files build only the separate frontend image, not the backend image.
Updates require an explicit replacement with a published, verified release
and its matching provenance. Containers do not download web code at runtime.
